notes: GeneReviews Hereditary Transthyretin Amyloidosis received a comprehensive update on 2024-05-30 and was reread in the current 1993-2026 NCBI edition.
MedlinePlus Transthyretin amyloidosis was live and reread on 2026-08-27.
NCBI Bookshelf Amyloidosis was used for differential amyloid precursor mechanisms and was live in the current StatPearls edition.

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

claim_audit.phenotype: GeneReviews supports progressive sensorimotor/autonomic neuropathy, restrictive cardiac amyloidosis, multiorgan involvement, Congo-red-positive deposits and autosomal-dominant inheritance in ATTRv.
claim_audit.correct_mechanism: GeneReviews Molecular Pathogenesis states that TTR is secreted as a tetramer, pathogenic variants reduce tetramer stability, tetramers dissociate into pro-amyloidogenic monomers, and monomers polymerize into amyloid fibrils.
claim_audit.medlineplus_confirmation: MedlinePlus independently states that TTR variants alter transthyretin structure, impair tetramer formation/stability, and permit individual TTR proteins to form fibrils and amyloid deposits.
claim_audit.distractor_1: NCBI Amyloidosis states that AL amyloidosis is caused by a plasma-cell clone producing amyloidogenic immunoglobulin light chains.
claim_audit.distractor_2: NCBI Amyloidosis identifies serum amyloid A as the precursor in AA amyloidosis associated with sustained chronic inflammation.
claim_audit.distractor_3: NCBI Amyloidosis identifies beta-2-microglobulin accumulation as dialysis-related amyloidosis in long-term hemodialysis.
claim_audit.distractor_4: NCBI Amyloidosis distinguishes amyloid-beta generated from amyloid precursor protein in Alzheimer disease as a CNS-localized amyloid mechanism.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The patient has inherited multisystem amyloidosis with neuropathy, autonomic dysfunction and cardiac involvement, and genetic testing explicitly identifies a heterozygous pathogenic TTR variant. The direct molecular consequence is destabilization of the TTR tetramer followed by amyloidogenic monomer formation.
adversarial_second_pass.al_challenge: AL can cause neuropathy and cardiomyopathy, but its fibrils derive from clonal immunoglobulin light chains and it does not explain the pathogenic TTR variant or autosomal-dominant pedigree.
adversarial_second_pass.aa_challenge: AA is driven by serum amyloid A in chronic inflammatory disease and typically has no TTR mutation.
adversarial_second_pass.beta2m_challenge: Dialysis-related beta-2-microglobulin amyloidosis requires prolonged beta-2-microglobulin retention in severe renal failure/hemodialysis, absent from the vignette.
adversarial_second_pass.amyloid_beta_challenge: Aβ/APP amyloid is primarily a CNS Alzheimer mechanism and does not explain peripheral/autonomic neuropathy plus restrictive cardiomyopathy with a TTR variant.
adversarial_second_pass.wild_type_attr_challenge: Wild-type ATTR can cause cardiac amyloidosis but does not contain a pathogenic TTR variant and does not explain the autosomal-dominant inherited phenotype.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: All five options describe true amyloid-forming mechanisms and are comparable in length and specificity.
adversarial_second_pass.hidden_assumption_check: No treatment, dose, prevalence, penetrance estimate or diagnostic threshold is required.
